title: 兽面纹 · 四步图片工作流 1.2
description: 补全与透明抠图 → 柔光参考 → 主纹剪影（白色装饰实体）→ 连续高度（刻线与眼部凹陷）。只有本次任务提供模型并要求匹配时，才添加 UV 遮罩匹配。

params.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the 
supplied close photograph of an ancient Chinese bronze taotie beast-face ornament. Reconstruct a COMPLETE isolated front-facing ornament from this cropped reference, as a clean reference for a relief workflow. Preserve the reference's paired large angular spiral horns at the upper left and right, small raised round eyes below, curled cheek/jaw hooks, central ridged vertical nose, and intricate narrow squared meander engraving on the broad raised bands. Extend the cropped upper and side edges conservatively by following existing bilateral structure; show the entire outline with 8 percent generous empty margin. Make the frontal layout balanced and bilaterally symmetric, with exactly one pair of eyes and one central nose, never add modern creature anatomy. No vessel, no surrounding rectangle or frame, no floor. Retain broad connected solid bronze bands and recessed fields between the ornamental bands; keep incised meander lines as surface carving, not holes. Present as an orthographic isolated museum ornament relief with subdued neutral dark bronze, greatly softened illumination and restrained patina, clear shallow carved detail. Preserve original character closely; missing sections are an artistic reconstruction. Genuine transparent background outside the ornament. No text, watermark, pedestal, cast shadow, extra motifs. Landscape 3:2 composition.

Use case: background-extraction and lighting-weather. Edit the supplied reconstructed bronze beast-face ornament. Keep EXACTLY the same canvas aspect ratio, silhouette location, every spiral, all curls and the meander engraving and eye positions. Remove the brown surrounding backdrop completely and produce actual RGBA TRANSPARENCY outside the ornament and in true negative spaces between disconnected ornamental curls. Do not erase dark incised lines or eye sockets or the small supports inside raised bands: they remain solid material. Flatten the illumination to softly and uniformly lit pale neutral clay-gray, remove bronze patina and spotty corrosion, retaining all fine carved lines and rounded structural depth. Orthographic front view, no cast shadow, no black photo shadows, no new shape or text. Clean technical soft-delighted reference, entire completed silhouette visible with original framing. Genuine transparent background.

nodes.title: 03 · 主纹剪影 · 白色装饰实体

params.prompt:
Extract the RAISED ORNAMENTAL RIBBONS of this beast-face design into a 2D black-and-white alpha stencil. Keep exact image dimensions, frontal registration, positions of paired horn spirals, eye disks, cheek curls, central stacked nose and outer flourishes. WHITE: the broad curled spiral ribbons, the round solid eye disks and their supporting short arms, central stacked nose column, curved cheeks and jaw hooks and edge curls. BLACK: all the recessed flat ground BETWEEN those ribbons, as well as all exterior. Separate the major ornamental bands visibly with generous black channels following the existing gaps, so the mask itself reads clearly as the spiral beast face, NOT a single filled plaque silhouette. Fill fine incised meander engravings ON a ribbon in white; no thin engraved noise, no gray, no shading. Treat the broad gaps between the raised ribbons as the background of this decorative silhouette; this alpha defines the raised motif, not the historical object's full material footprint. Strict pure black background and clean solid white ribbons with clear gaps. No text or border. Preserve all large recognizable features, layout and margin.
Edit this exact black-and-white stencil. Fill the TWO large circular eye centers at lower-middle left and right completely solid PURE WHITE, so eyes are solid white disks, never donut holes. Also fill the TWO small black circular pits at the ends of the long upper spiral ribbons pure white. Fill any other fully enclosed tiny black carved pits white. Preserve ALL exterior background channels and all silhouette edges, curls, layout, pixel registration and canvas exactly. Pure binary white motif on black. No 3D shading or gray and absolutely no redesign.

nodes.title: 04 · 连续高度 · 刻线与眼部凹陷

params.prompt: Create a precise grayscale DISPLACEMENT HEIGHT MAP of the beast-face ornament. Input 1 is the authoritative binary silhouette/layout: all black regions MUST remain pure black, and every white ribbon, nose segment, eye disk and curl stays in exactly the same position and outline. Input 2 provides the fine carved meander details and relief hierarchy to map ONLY inside those white shapes. White is high, black is zero; use rich continuous gray slopes inside shapes, highest round eye bosses and central nose, medium high broad horn curls, slightly lower cheek curls, very shallow recessed meander engraving on the ribbon surface. Eye pupils are shallow dark-gray depressions on solid disks, never black holes. No lighting direction, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no metallic reflections, no patina or noise. This is a depth data image, NOT a lit 3D clay render. Preserve entire canvas, 1536x1024 landscape framing and registration with input 1. Crisp silhouette boundaries, gentle bevels, readable fine geometric engraving, no extra details outside the mask, no labels, no frame. Render neutral grayscale only, plain pure black background.
